project.name: eloup
project.intent: Multi-game ELO tracking website for parties. Players log in, record results across multiple game types, and see per-game and aggregate ratings.

architecture.description: Core stack: Next.js app (App Router) backed by SQLite via a single deployable Node process. Server actions handle score entry; better-sqlite3 owns the DB file.

auth.description: Per-player login. Each player has an account; results are entered by one participant and require confirmation from the other(s) before they affect ratings.

rating.description: ELO rating per (player, game). Aggregate cross-game rating is a derived view, not the source of truth.

deployment.description: Single Next.js process with the SQLite file mounted on persistent storage. Target host is decided post-MVP.
